loadedTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the page was loaded

httpStatusCode.description: HTTP response status code (currently always 200; see SPEC)

depth.description: Link distance from a start URL (0 for start URLs)

referrerUrl.description: The linking page URL, or null for start URLs

hash.description: MD5 hex digest of the content

bytes.description: UTF-8 byte length of the content

content.description: Inline content string. Present when this format targets the dataset (a "*-dataset" token). May co-exist with "key"/"url" when the format also targets the key-value store.

key.description: Key-value store key. Present when this format targets the key-value store (a "*-kvs" token). May co-exist with inline "content" when the format also targets the dataset.

url.description: Public URL to the key-value store item. Present when stored to a public store.

original.description: The raw page HTML. "hash" and "bytes" are always present. When an "original-*" token is in save, the raw HTML is included as "content" (an "original-dataset" token) and/or referenced by "key"/"url" (an "original-kvs" token).
